card.name: Hyphens and words in dash-separated lists
card.fires_on: Small joining pieces such as hyphens, spaces or short words inside hyphenated names or just before a dash-started list item. It is strongest in odd web text, such as hyphenated village-name translations and dash-bullet lists.

modes.label: Hyphenated name glosses
modes.description: Hyphen or word piece inside a long hyphen-joined translated place name.

modes.label: Before dash bullets
modes.description: Space or quote mark at the end of a line just before the next dash-started list item.

card.writes: It slightly favors word beginnings like fac, pur, ess and fab, so a new word is likely to start next.
card.plain: It marks spots inside hyphen-chained names and dash-bullet lists where a new word is about to begin.
